title: Dural Venous Sinuses of the Brain (OpenStax)
author: OpenStax
caption: Dural venous sinuses of the brain (superior sagittal, transverse, sigmoid, and cavernous sinuses), showing cranial venous drainage pathways affected by microgravity cephalic fluid shift.
alt_text: Anatomical illustration of the dural venous sinuses of the human brain.
clinical_relevance: Microgravity-induced cephalad fluid shift impairs cerebral venous outflow and increases dural venous sinus pressure, contributing to space adaptation headache.
